carousel.nri_angle: Indian-origin quants, traders and data engineers in global finance hubs are among the users who would run intraday back-tests on LSEG data if their firms adopt the GPU pipeline.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Cabinet Approves Fairfax's ₹52,878-Crore Bid for Controlling Stake in IDBI Bank
carousel.excerpt: Fairfax will acquire 60.72% of IDBI Bank from the government and LIC in what New Delhi calls the largest FDI ever in India's financial sector, subject to RBI clearance.
carousel.image_caption: An IDBI Bank branch. The Cabinet approved Fairfax's bid for a controlling stake in IDBI Bank.
carousel.nri_angle: NRI depositors and investors in Indian banks get a new controlling shareholder at IDBI Bank, while the government and LIC remain minority holders with a combined 34%.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
